summary: Verified the small scoped fix on top of already-verified duel-sharing feature: (1) app.json scheme='qapilo' confirmed via code review. (2) Logged in as demo@tradequest.app, created a duel via Challenge-a-friend CTA, played through the 5-question duel, reached results view, tapped duel-share (testID duel-share), and intercepted the actual navigator.share() call in-browser to capture the real message content. Captured message exactly matches spec: plain-text fallback ('Open the app -> Challenge a friend -> Enter code: {duel_id}') followed by '\n\nqapilo://duel/{duel_id}'. No Metro/bundling errors observed; app loads and navigates correctly (onboarding -> auth -> Home -> duel creation -> results) with no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json: scheme correctly set to 'qapilo' (was 'frontend' placeholder). slug remains 'frontend' which is unrelated to the scheme and does not need to change.
Deep link tap-through (qapilo://duel/{id} actually opening app to correct screen) is out of scope per task note -- cannot be tested in Expo web preview, requires native build.
seed_data_creation: One duel created as demo@tradequest.app (duel_id 5422f725) during share-message verification test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scoped fix fully verified: app.json scheme=qapilo confirmed, share message format confirmed exact via runtime interception (fallback text + code + deep link), no regressions in login/duel-create/play/results flow, no bundling errors.
